entries.notes: One chi router exposes public, pre-ready, and ready-gated HTTP surfaces. Recovery contracts replace individual paths in place; no second HTTP service is authorized.

The current RPC returns SQL-backed issues, rules, and recent memories without task ranking. It remains only during migration to the query-driven retrieval packet.
